description: The actual shared propositional CNF of a finite Horn theory is true under a valuation exactly when that valuation's true set models the theory.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HornClauses.formula_bridge.{u} {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α]
  (Γ : Finset (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HornClauses.Rule α))
  (v : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.Valuation α) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.eval v (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HornClauses.formula Γ) = true ↔
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HornClauses.models Γ {p | v p = true}
